scope: Actual local dashboard/API launched on isolated ports17862/18012; login and tab navigation; fire history; statistics; review decoding; model smoke inference; existing tests. Existing user edits in dashboard/app.py and events.py preserved.

tests.ingestion: 5212 events and3912 observations; zero new duplicates inserted; zero conflicts

findings.title: Statistics tab errors on mixed timestamp precision
findings.reproduction: Login then #10 종합 데이터; actual UI shows 오류. stats_html(current_262_rows) raises ValueError: unconverted data remains .0
findings.cause: Integer-second and fractional-second strings are parsed with one inferred pandas format
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve numeric source seconds or normalize timestamp parsing in one shared helper; add mixed-timestamp statistics regression.

findings.title: Main KPI includes future fire events
findings.reproduction: live_until(current_rows,0.1) includes all four fire rows at4.0/4.6/8.2/8.8
findings.cause: Mixed timestamp parse errors coerce fractional fire rows to NaT, then fillna(0) treats them as immediate events
findings.recommended_fix: Use normalized source seconds; do not convert invalid timestamps to zero.

findings.title: Playback and event clock are independent
findings.reproduction: Actual parking video loop enabled and pausable; event clock uses time.time()-tab-entry. Saw current video position6sec with8.8sec row already visible after elapsed wall clock exceeded duration.
findings.cause: No video currentTime/pause/seek/loop synchronization; wall clock continues across pause and loop
findings.recommended_fix: Choose explicitly between cumulative-session history and current-playback history; live camera table should follow actual playhead if intended as synchronized demo.

limits: Not a complete fresh re-inference of all six source videos
